scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --local --env local --ip 0.0.0.0
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/check-assets.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint src worker shared tests scripts/deploy-demo.mjs scripts/deployment-config.mjs scripts/benchmark-sampling.mjs scripts/check-gallery.mjs scripts/benchmark-preloading.mjs scripts/scan-similarity.mjs scripts/real-similarity.v1.0.0.mjs scripts/check-live-assets.mjs
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p '*_test.py'
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env local
scripts.db:seed: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --env local --file scripts/seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --env local --file scripts/seed-publication.sql
